verdict.rationale: Viam documents the whole loop. Robot data is captured and synced to the cloud, even through outages (viam-docs-51, viam-docs-7). Datasets are created, annotated and used to train models in the cloud, with an ML Training API for submitting jobs (viam-docs-8, viam-docs-61). Trained models are pushed so machines pull them automatically, with versioning, staging, canary testing and rollback via OTA (viam-docs-9, viam-docs-48, viam-docs-26). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end loop, and in-depth docs on training (supported architectures, how captured data becomes training datasets) rather than overview-level marketing claims.
